hero.headline: I build software.
hero.description: From production applications to experimental interfaces, I enjoy turning ideas into software that feels simple, useful and intentional.

introduction.title: Software is more than code.
introduction.body: I enjoy working across the entire product journey — understanding a problem, shaping an interface, designing the architecture and turning it into something people can actually use.
introduction.secondaryBody: My work spans web, backend and mobile development, with a particular interest in minimal interfaces, developer experience and thoughtful product design.

about.title: Curious by default.
paragraphs: I'm a software developer who enjoys understanding how things work and turning that understanding into useful software.
I care about interfaces, architecture and the small details that make a product feel finished.
When I'm not working on a product, I like building experiments simply because I want to know if I can.
